description: Connect VS Code to your AI Code Studio: build websites and write HTML, CSS and JavaScript non-stop, straight into your editor.

aiStudio.serverUrl.description: Base URL of your running AI Code Studio app (for example http://localhost:3000 or your hosted preview URL).

aiStudio.burstLines.description: Lines the AI writes in each burst.

aiStudio.deletePercent.description: Percentage of each burst that is deleted before the writer continues.

aiStudio.delayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between written lines, so you can watch the code appear.

aiStudio.maxLines.description: The writer keeps at most this many lines in the file by trimming the top.
